definition_en: The ability to guide, motivate, and inspire others, build consensus, and influence stakeholders to achieve shared goals.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk membimbing, memotivasi dan memberi inspirasi kepada orang lain, membina kata sepakat, serta mempengaruhi pihak berkepentingan bagi mencapai matlamat bersama.
typical_tasks_en:
• Convince the cross-functional team to adopt a shared project timeline.
• Rally the customer service team to meet the month-end target after a slow start.
• Mediate a disagreement between two team members over task ownership.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Pujuk pasukan merentas fungsi untuk menerima pakai garis masa projek yang sama.
• Galakkan pasukan khidmat pelanggan mencapai sasaran akhir bulan selepas permulaan yang perlahan.
• Mediasi perselisihan antara dua ahli pasukan mengenai pemilikan tugasan.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires guiding, directing, or coordinating a team
• The task involves persuading or influencing stakeholders
• The task requires motivating others toward a common goal
• The task involves making decisions that affect a group
• The task requires building consensus or resolving group conflicts
exclusion_rules:
• The task is performed entirely independently with no team interaction
• The user only reports information upward without influencing decisions
• The task involves following someone else's direction without leading
• The user provides input but has no role in shaping group outcomes
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task mentions a team but does not say the person directs, influences, or aligns others.

confusions.boundary_rule: Leadership is about direction and influence. Teaching is about developing individual skills.
confusions.example_task: Guide a junior colleague through a difficult client negotiation while building their confidence.
confusions.expected_labels: Leadership and social influence; Teaching and mentoring

confusions.boundary_rule: Leadership focuses on guiding the current team. Talent management focuses on attracting, retaining, and developing workforce capacity.
confusions.example_task: Persuade senior management to invest in leadership training for high-potential staff.
confusions.expected_labels: Leadership and social influence; Talent management

confusions.boundary_rule: Leadership uses empathy as a tool but is ultimately about direction and influence. Empathy is about understanding others' feelings.
confusions.example_task: Listen to team concerns and then decide how to restructure the shift rosters.
confusions.expected_labels: Leadership and social influence; Empathy and active listening
